Messages.Author: Nac
Messages.Body:
Hi

How does it work now, with Psyche! being inside the combat and Obedience being a reaction?

Messages.Author: Suoli
Messages.Body: Psyche!, Freak Drive, Cat's Guidance or any other minion card that I can think of (that doesn't cancel Obedience as it is played) has never been allowed during or at the end of an action after Obedience has been played as playing Obedience explicitly ends the action, right then and there. There's no "at the end of the action/combat" window where Psyche! could theoretically be playable.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Nac wrote:
> Hi
>
> How does it work now, with Psyche! being inside the combat and Obedience being a reaction?
>
Roughly speaking, there's little practical change.

I'm actind, and in combat with you. Combat is about to end, but I play Psyche!.
Combat ends.
The Psyche! effect kicks in, and starts a new combat.
At this point, you can play Obedience, because the requirements are met.
Untapping and tapping occurs, and the action ends.

The only practical difference is that I played Psyche! in combat, rather than immediately after combat.
